environment.description: Same Tomcat deployment but database connectivity routed through PgBouncer 1.18 in transaction pooling mode with a custom query parser module (pgbouncer-rr with routing rules). The pg_hba.conf on the RDS proxy enforces that the application role 'report_ro' connects, which has been configured with a row-level security policy. Additionally, the RDS instance has parameter group with 'session_preload_libraries' set to load the 'pg_stat_statements' extension AND a custom extension 'pgaudit_analyze' that enforces a statement whitelist. The whitelist is maintained in a separate schema (audit.allowed_statements) and only permits queries matching parameterized templates. Any query not matching a registered template hash is rejected with ERROR before execution. The template registry contains only: 'SELECT table_name, owner_id FROM reports WHERE id = $1' and 'SELECT * FROM {ident} WHERE owner_id = {int} AND created_at > $1'. The {ident} placeholder only matches single SQL identifiers and {int} matches integer literals. The $1 placeholder requires the value to parse as a valid timestamp literal with no additional SQL tokens.

config.proxy: pgbouncer-1.18 transaction pooling with pgbouncer-rr routing
config.statement_whitelist_enforcement: pgaudit_analyze extension rejects non-matching queries pre-execution
registered_templates: SELECT table_name, owner_id FROM reports WHERE id = $1
SELECT * FROM {ident} WHERE owner_id = {int} AND created_at > $1
config.template_rules: {ident} matches ^[a-zA-Z_][a-zA-Z0-9_]*$, {int} matches ^[0-9]+$, $1 must parse as timestamp with no trailing tokens
config.row_level_security: POLICY report_access ON ALL TABLES USING (owner_id = current_setting('app.current_owner')::int)
